label: Nasdaq 100 Trailing P/E (cap-weighted) + Forward P/E (12-month forward consensus, weekly)

source.method: Terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus P/E, weekly
source.perTicker: constituent trailing-twelve-month EPS, one snapshot per name
source.forwardOwnMethod: Blended forward 12M: FY1/FY2 consensus net income weighted by published ETF holdings; one point per day. Agrees with the terminal blended-forward series to within 3% on all four universes (verified 2026-08-05).

note: Trailing PE is cap-weighted Σ(w·P)/Σ(w·trailingEps) computed from the 100 NDX constituents daily; with no comparable long-run series for NDX no historical seed is shown yet, and the line will fill in over time as we update regularly. Forward PE is terminal data — 12-month blended-forward consensus estimates back to April 2001, published as one point per week (the last reading of each week). Alongside it we publish a second forward series computed daily from consensus estimates and published ETF holdings, never blended into the first.
